// Vendored snapshot. Do not edit — re-export instead.

{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.18

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Get the local player's current locked target (with weapons that can lock on).

|s1= [[playerTargetLock]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [target, lockValue, config]
* target: [[Object]] - the locked object
* lockValue: [[Number]] - in range 0..1 where 1 is fully locked
* config: [[Config]] - used weapon's {{hl|CfgWeapons}} config

|x1= <sqf>
playerTargetLock params ["_target", "_lock", "_cfg"];
if (_lock == 1) then
{
	hint format ["%1 locked %2", getText (_cfg >> "displayName"), getText (configOf _target >> "displayName")];
};
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>playerTargetLock; // returns [objNull, 0, configNull] if no lock is being done</sqf>

|seealso= [[cursorTarget]]
}}
